# btpservice_cicd_credential_secret_text (Resource)

Manages a Secret Text credential in the SAP BTP CI/CD service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "btpservice_cicd_credential_secret_text" "example" {
  name        = "my-api-token"
  description = "API token for accessing an external service"
  text        = "my-secret-api-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Credential name Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and dots.
- `text` (String, Sensitive) The secret text value. Not returned by the API on reads — stored only in Terraform state.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the resource (assigned by the API).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```terraform
# terraform import btpservice_cicd_credential_secret_text.<resource_name> <credential_name>

terraform import btpservice_cicd_credential_secret_text.example my-api-token

# terraform import using id attribute in import block

import {
  to = btpservice_cicd_credential_secret_text.<resource_name>
  id = "<credential_name>"
}

# this resource supports import using identity attribute from Terraform version 1.12 or higher

import {
  to = btpservice_cicd_credential_secret_text.<resource_name>
  identity = {
    id = "<credential_name>"
  }
}
```
